briefdescription.para: If the !callee metadata was present, this set will contain all potential callees (superset).
This set contains all currently assumed calllees, which might grow over time.

The actual update/transfer function which has to be implemented by the derived classes.

\Return CHANGED if the internal state changed, otherwise UNCHANGED.

briefdescription.para: Hook to enable custom statistic tracking, called after manifest that resulted in a change if statistics are enabled.

detaileddescription.para: We require subclasses to provide an implementation so we remember to add statistics for them.

briefdescription.para: Call \CB on each potential callee value and return true if all were known and CB returned true on all of them.
